gaps.explanation: The only business-type detail line is Schedule 5 (p15, Combined Statement of Cash Receipts and Disbursements - Compared to Budget - Budgetary Cash Basis) 'Proprietary' receipts actual 333,260 (detail index 63). The statement figure is accrual basis: Exhibit H (p8) Totals 2025 Total operating revenue 331,517 (Utility collections 331,272 + Miscellaneous 245) + non-operating Interest Income 2,688 = 334,205. 334,205 - 333,260 = 945 is the accrual vs budgetary cash basis difference; both printed totals are correct as printed. No fix.

Schedule 5 (p15, budgetary cash basis) 'Proprietary' disbursements actual 333,870 (detail index 64) vs Exhibit H (p8, accrual) Total operating expenses 323,151 (incl. Depreciation 76,267) + Interest paid on long term debt 5,772 = 328,923. The cash disbursements include capital and principal payments and exclude depreciation; difference 333,870 - 328,923 = 4,947 is the basis difference. No fix.
